verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's Router documents built-in retries across deployments and providers, with fixed and exponential backoff, a configurable num_retries setting, and cooldowns and timeouts. Calls that still fail after retries fall back automatically to another model group. Missing for 10: documentation of per-error-type retry policies (which transient errors trigger retries, e.g. rate limits vs timeouts), and independent or hands-on corroboration of retry behavior.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set automatic retry policies for transient provider errors

citations.quote: Basic reliability logic - cooldowns, fallbacks, timeouts and retries (fixed + exponential backoff) across multiple deployments/providers.
Built-in retry / fallback logic across multiple deployments via the [Router](/docs/routing)
If a call fails after num_retries, LiteLLM falls back to another model group
